name: scenario-to-cloud.cloud-qemu-qualification
purpose: Admit one QEMU-lane qualification request, refuse absent authorization, incompatible target, stale artifact or unknown fault before mutation, deploy the fixture via plan, apply and wait, observe health, and return standing.

release_ref.description: Immutable release manifest digest sha256:<64 hex>; a mutable reference is refused as stale_artifact.

target_ref.description: Owned disposable guest identity local-qemu:<id>; any other target is refused as incompatible_target.

environment_ref.description: Isolated test environment id the deployment is bound to.

workload_ref.description: Declaration-derived fixture id from fixtures/workloads or fixtures/coexistence.

authorization_ref.description: Operator grant reference designating target_ref as a disposable owned fixture; absent means refused.

cases.description: Matrix case ids; every id must be a cell of certification/lanes/qemu.json.

faults.description: faults.allowed lists lane fault capabilities (worker_restart, lease_expiry, lost_reply, transport_disconnect, target_reboot, data_interruption).

deployment_id.description: Optional exact deployment id on the owned guest; empty resolves by (workload_ref as scenario_id, environment_ref).

assumptions: scenario-to-cloud is running and its connect-rpc bindings deployment/get, deployment/resolve, deployment/plan, deployment/apply, operation/wait, deployment/health and edge/status are governed

the operator has already created and snapshotted the owned guest with vps instance create / wait-for-ssh / snapshot (REST pre-step) and bound a fixture deployment to it (target machine_id equals target_ref)
the session holds the destructive grant for deployment/apply (effect:destructive or the binding's permission); without it the act phase ends refused/no_grant and nothing was mutated
certification/lanes/qemu.json is the required-cell set for the lane and api/certification/lanes_test.go keeps this program's QEMU_CASES equal to it
fault injection arming and target receipt reads have no governed binding yet; fault cells stay pending after the deploy journey and are named in the envelope
host tools qemu and cloud-localds are installed only through vrooli setup (EXT-06); the program never installs anything
invariants: admission refuses an absent authorization grant, an incompatible target, a stale artifact, an unknown fault capability, a non-zero spend ceiling and a case outside the lane before any read or write
the only mutation is one deployment/apply of the compiled plan digest with request_id as the idempotency key; the same request replays the admitted operation
a deployment whose target machine_id differs from target_ref is never applied to
no shell string or opaque argv is forwarded; every effect goes through a declared scenario-to-cloud binding
a non-terminal operation after the bounded wait is reported with its id, never converted into a failure
no cell is marked passed by this program; receipts require per-case assertions and target receipts
at most one row is materialized per binding call
one envelope is printed on every path

bindings.note: Used when deployment_id is empty: selector (scenario_id=workload_ref, environment=environment_ref).
Requires the session grant and _confirm; refused otherwise.
An unreachable observation leaves health unknown; the journey is then unverified, not failed.

signals.standing: refused, admitted, ready_to_act, no_op, applied_without_operation, operation_pending, journey_failed, journey_unverified or journey_verified
signals.cells: [{case_id, lane, verdict, operation_ref?}] with verdict pending or pending_assertions; never passed
signals.target: target_ref, environment_ref, workload_ref and the bound deployment_id
signals.deployment: resolved deployment id, scenario, environment, machine_id, transport
signals.plan: plan_digest, release_digest and closure_status of the compiled plan
signals.operation: operation_id, state, terminal, fence after apply and one bounded wait
signals.health: status, freshness, observed_release_digest from the health observation
signals.edge: route and private listener counts from the edge observation
signals.validation_run: unavailable when the latest test-genie run could not be read
signals.fault_injection: present when faults were requested: names the missing governed binding
signals.faults_allowed: fault capabilities admitted for this run
signals.next_action: the one operator or owner action that moves the qualification forward

outputs.evidence: authorization reference, lane and image manifest paths, latest test-genie run id, operation id; receipts land in certification/evidence/<CASE>.qemu.json once assertions are collected

budget.async_reason: deployment/apply plus one bounded operation wait exceeds the 120 s synchronous bound

fixtures.note: Admission refuses before any binding is called, so this fixture needs no running scenario.
Admitted; no deployment is bound to the fixture selector so collect refuses incompatible_target (404), or unavailable when scenario-to-cloud is down.
deployment/get 404 is refused as incompatible_target before any mutation.
